speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms first began?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or changes in fetal movement? I also need to know if you have a history of liver disease or if you are taking any medications.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of ice cream consumption and your current symptoms, I am concerned about Listeriosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, REQUEST TEST: Listerial_Serology

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood Cultures: Positive for Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium. Listerial Serology: Not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results are classic for Listeria monocytogenes, confirming the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
